page.overview:
Who is Mathiren?

Mathiren was a Sith pureblood male who was a Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic.

Mathiren was first introduced as a Flashpoint Vendor in Game Update 2.7 for Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel.
